customManagers.description: Docker image tags pinned as PHP string literals in ServiceDefinition classes -- Renovate's built-in dockerfile manager only scans actual Dockerfiles (which it already covers natively: stubs/docker/php/Dockerfile*, stubs/docker/garage/Dockerfile), not these.

packageRules.description: Every pinned image here is checked and chosen deliberately (see docs/adding-a-service.md's "Pin image tags" note) -- group them into one PR per run instead of one PR per image, so a version bump gets one human review pass, not several.
